_note: Presentation metadata for the rules corpus categories, mirroring src-tauri/data/agency-categories.json (the agent side). `icon` is a Lucide PascalCase name bound in src/lib/util/categoryIcon.ts; `color` is a hex accent. The rules corpus is upstream content and will grow, so a category with no entry here is NOT an error: it renders with the neutral fallback (Layers icon, grey accent, title-cased slug) and is never dropped. Read by src/lib/data/ruleCategories.ts; the Rust side never renders a category label, so it does not read this file (issue #66).
